description: Compliance under Legal Metrology (Packaged Commodities) Rules 2011 and Drugs and Cosmetics Rules, 1945.

requirements.title: Generic Name of Drug / Medicine
requirements.legal_reference: Rule 96, Drugs & Cosmetics Rules 1945 / LM Rule 6(1)(a)
requirements.description: Proper generic or International Non-proprietary Name (INN) of the drug must be declared.
requirements.recommendation_template: Print the generic chemical or drug formulation name prominently on the label.

requirements.title: Manufacturer Name & Licensed Address
requirements.description: Name and address of the licensed pharmaceutical manufacturer must be declared.
requirements.recommendation_template: Provide registered manufacturing license number and facility address.

requirements.title: Date of Manufacture (Mfg. Date)
requirements.description: Month and year of manufacture must be clearly printed on the label.
requirements.recommendation_template: Clearly print Manufacturing Date (Mfg. Date) on the label.

requirements.title: Date of Expiry (Exp. Date)
requirements.description: Date of expiry after which the drug must not be used must be printed.
requirements.recommendation_template: Ensure Expiry Date is clearly printed and not obscured on the label.

requirements.title: Net Quantity (Tablets / Capsules / ml)
requirements.description: Number of dosage units (tablets, capsules) or liquid volume must be declared.
requirements.recommendation_template: State exact count of dosage units (e.g., 10 Tablets) or volume (e.g., 100 ml).

requirements.title: Maximum Retail Price — MRP (Incl. of all taxes)
requirements.legal_reference: DPCO (Drugs Price Control Order) / LM Rule 6(1)(e)
requirements.description: Retail price conforming to DPCO ceiling price guidelines, inclusive of all taxes.
requirements.recommendation_template: Ensure price does not exceed NPPA ceiling price and includes all taxes.
